* '''Original''' (this page): known by 10 October 2015. Actual source: [[:File:PC-Set2-PalaceRaider-2015-10-10-slip.png]]. Printed mark: no errata mark. Bottom caption: “Palace Raider”. While driving a vehicle, it is power +3, defense value +1, and moves for free.”<ref name="palace-set2-2015">Players Committee, [[:File:Virtual-Set-2-October-2015-capture.pdf|Virtual Set 2 sheet, archived 10 October 2015]], page 2. Original capture: [https://web.archive.org/web/20151010191753/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/virtual/Set-2.pdf Internet Archive]. The timestamp proves availability by that date, not initial publication.</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Palace Raider (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]]): known by 6 August 2016; identical in the 5 July 2017 capture. Actual source: [[:File:PC-Set2-PalaceRaider-2016-08-06-slip.png]]. The lower-face slip visibly supplies power 1, ability 2, deploy 2, forfeit 3, Pilot/Warrior and Set2 icons, game text and “Original concept by Brian Fred”. It does not reproduce the upper card face. Destiny 2, the upper Palace Raider title/lore and Alien type are inherited from the named underlying Decipher card, verified against its unchanged original archive face [[:File:JPSD-L-palaceraider-decipher-archive.gif]]. Artwork is not reconstructed. Catalogue rarity is not independently established by this crop and is omitted from these new partial articles. No unrelated strategy or contemporary Scomp rulings are imported.
